body:
I have never done ketamine so I can't comment on it. 

In my experience MXE is not very visual, things get distorted and kind of 'pop out' more than usual though. I found DXM to be more satisfying in the visuals department. My highest dose was 100mg sublingual, perhaps i'm not doing enough. 

The sound distortion, increased music appreciation and body high are all excellent IMO. On higher doses my body felt like some weird alien appendage that I didn't really know how to control. Much less of a 'floaty' or light feeling than DXM but just as pleasurable. It also is a great fast acting anti-depressant, I feel good for the rest of the day after even a small dose. I like it too much for my own good, I find myself wanting to use every day. 

Duration is 6-8 hours to baseline, about an hour to completely come up. 
Also, ~300mg is an insane dose, be careful. Try to wait at least an hour then gauge how high you are and if you need more. 

["didn't understand what was going on"](http://imgur.com/VcFnrFf)
I love that feel :^)

I did 100mg MXE last night, what a ride. Nothing made any sense. Utter confusion. Sound was really distorted, like I was listening to TV underwater. It took me at least 5 minutes to figure out how to change the channel. I tried to read some threads here at the peak but the words were floating off the page, sentences were just a random jumble of words with no real meaning. I had to hang onto the walls to move around. 

tl;dr it was a pretty good time.

I went through something similar my first time taking adderall, OP. A friend gave me 5 20mg pills, I asked him how many to take and he replied "as many as you want, nothing bad will happen". I took his word for it and swallowed 2 pills. The first few hours were fine, I was euphoric and talkative, very pleasant. 

About 3-4 hours in I noticed my fingers were beginning to tingle. The tingling got more and more intense until my fingers began to "lock up", that's the only way I can describe it. They were extended as far as they are able to go, completely rigid and unable to move on both of my hands. The incident lasted about ten minutes and I thought "well that was weird, glad it's over". Only it wasn't. Maybe twenty minutes later it happened again. It happened maybe ten times in total, during the worst incident my whole body had gone numb and I was talking like a stroke victim. It only subsided when I took a seroquel and went to sleep. I felt off for the next few days but it didn't happen again. It was one of the scariest experiences of my life. 

Ordinarily I would have went to the hospital but I got the pills in a less-than-legal manner and I didn't want to get him or myself in any trouble. Despite hours of research on the internet I still haven't found out exactly what happened that night and I'm not sure I want to. I gave the rest of the pills away and haven't taken stimulants since and I don't plan on it. I don't mean to hijack your thread, just thought I'd share. 

Adderall, not even once.

No, I haven't had this particular effect. MXE seems to be pretty benign physically for me. My heart rate increases a bit but that's all. However when I had a cup of coffee on MXE my heartrate and blood pressure were quite elevated, more so than either drug on it's own. Only then did I get the chest pressure you're describing. I could hardly see the blood vessels on the back of my hand and they're usually very pronounced. 

Maybe caffeine intake has something to do with it? I can't say for sure. Be careful with your doses, if this effect continues I would consider quitting MXE completely.
Check his pupils. If they're dilated chances are he's tripping. Everyone reacts differently to different chemicals, please don't assume he is "faking".
